architecture_a.design: frozen dataclass specification plus direct typed pipeline functions

cold_import.protocol: fresh subprocesses, interleaved A then B

auditability_notes: strong static top-level typing and explicit provider boundary
nested scientific contracts occupy an opaque mutable extra mapping
the declaration has no single canonical authority seal
lifecycle order is spread across direct functions

architecture_b.design: canonically sealed scientific record plus explicit operation interpreter

cold_import.protocol: fresh subprocesses, interleaved A then B

auditability_notes: all lifecycle and scientific contracts are explicit record fields
canonical record authority detects pre-execution scientific drift
declared operation order is visible and validated
independent verifier is a data-only callback with no Architecture A import
plain records trade static field typing for runtime validation and canonical authority

performance_investigation.cause: Architecture B recomputes the canonical authority hash over the complete scientific record before every interpretation
performance_investigation.disposition: retain fail-closed authority validation; remeasure with real providers where DSP, estimation, and gate execution dominate by orders of magnitude

selection.reason: B is the lower coherent design: 49.2 percent fewer engine LOC, three fewer engine modules, four fewer public symbols, four fewer dependency edges, a smaller orientation surface, a sealed declaration authority, and a more explicit audit path. The measured 9.793 microsecond interpreter overhead is understood and does not offset the structural reduction.
